**Worker registration.** One worker per service polls its own queue `rwb-<short>` in namespace `rwb-recovery`, with its own workload identity and a client certificate whose subject names the service. The queues are created at platform install from the service catalogue, and a worker that polls a queue other than its own is refused. Each service has its own codec key under the namespace key. The smoke workflow starts through RWB-PLT-E1070-APP on one named service queue. The 06:00 JOB-22 platform run is outside this story. SIT evidence is recorded beside the run report, and grant evidence is taken from the rwb-access access review.
